add_params_argparse: add argparse arguments for hyperbolic GNN training on the PROTEINS dataset to an existing parser
configure_optimizer: configure the optimizer type and learning rate for hyperbolic graph neural network training
set_gnn_architecture: set the GNN layer count, embedding size, and activation function for hyperbolic models
configure_data_paths: configure the train, validation, and test file paths for the PROTEINS dataset
set_hyperbolic_options: set hyperbolic manifold embedding options including optimizer, manifold type, and projection initialization
